trip.title: Korea Trip — Myeongdong, Seoul to Busan

records.submitted: Flight from SFO to ICN Airport
records.notes: No airline, flight number or schedule was provided and none was checked. Date conflict: the Day 1 header reads 'Oct.31/Nov 1' and the day is labelled Sunday. Oct 31, 2026 is a Saturday and Nov 1, 2026 is a Sunday, so confirm the departure and arrival dates on the ticket.

records.item: AREX airport train, ICN → Seoul Station
records.submitted: Arex (airport train) 45 min, $7
records.official_transit: Express (non-stop): 43 min from Incheon Airport Terminal 1, 51 min from Terminal 2, to Seoul Station. All-stop: 59 min from T1, 66 min from T2. Express departs every 20–40 min.
records.official_detail: Seoul Station connects to KTX, Gyeongui–Jungang Line and Seoul Metro lines 1 and 4 (official).
records.notes: '45 min' does not match the official 43 min (T1) or 51 min (T2) for the express. '$7' does not match either official fare. No USD conversion was entered because no official exchange rate was used.

records.item: Airport limousine bus to Myeongdong (listed as '$13')
records.submitted: Airport Limousine bus $13
records.official_location: Route 6001 stop list includes Myeongdong Station (명동역) and Incheon Airport Terminal 1 and 2.
records.official_transit: Seoul Metropolitan Government: airport limousine buses take about 60–80 min (varies by route and traffic); fares ₩5,000–15,000 by bus (general range).
records.official_detail: Route 6001 is cash, Tmoney or transit card; no online reservation (official notice).
records.notes: '$13' is not confirmed. The operator's route page lists ₩17,000 for route 6001, while the Seoul government page gives a general ₩5,000–15,000 range. The operator figure is entered. Confirm the terminal (T1 or T2) and the bus route before you travel.

records.submitted: Check into Stanford Hotel in Myeongdong
records.official_transit: Euljiro 1-ga Station about 5 min walk (official property page).
records.official_detail: Hotel property page lists 370 rooms; some third-party sites list 243 (not used).
records.notes: Check-in opens at 15:00. If you arrive earlier, ask the hotel about luggage storage.

records.submitted: Light neighborhood exploration, settle in, and rest from jet lag.
records.notes: Planning note; nothing to verify.

records.item: Bus to N Seoul Tower (31 min ride)
records.submitted: Take bus to Namsan Tower (N Seoul Tower). 31 min bus ride.
records.notes: Bus route, 31-minute ride time and bus fare are not confirmed by an official source in this review. Day 2 header year reads '2006'; the calendar date Nov 2, 2026 is a Monday, which matches the plan. Official cable car access is at Myeongdong Station Exit 3 (see REF-01).

records.item: N Seoul Tower observatory + cable car ('$31 each')
records.submitted: For cable car + Observatory ticket: $31 each.
records.official_fee: Observatory: adult (13+) ₩29,000; child (3–12) and senior (65+) ₩23,000. Cable car: adult round trip ₩15,000, adult one way ₩12,000; child round trip ₩11,500, child one way ₩9,000.
records.official_detail: Official pages list the observatory and cable car fares separately. No combined package price was found on an official page.
records.notes: Component fares verified. The '$31 each' combined price is not confirmed by an official source.

records.submitted: Observatory 10:00–10:30 (entry until 10:00)
records.official_hours: Weekdays 10:00–22:30; weekends and holidays 10:00–23:00. Open 365 days. Closed to new visitors 30 min before closing.
records.notes: The submitted '10:00–10:30' does not match the official hours.

records.submitted: Cable Car Hours: 10:00-10:30 (weather permitting)
records.official_hours: Cable car 10:00–23:00. Hours may change with weather and operating schedules.
records.official_location: Boarding: Myeongdong Station (Line 4) Exit 3, then a 10–15 min walk.
records.official_detail: Namsan Ormi (inclined elevator) 09:00–23:00, free; suspended Mondays 09:00–14:00 for maintenance (official).
records.notes: The submitted '10:00–10:30' does not match the official 10:00–23:00.

records.submitted: Myeongdong Shopping District (Seoul's main shopping district). Fashion, food stalls, K-beauty.

records.submitted: Department store hours (Lotte/Shinsegae): 10:30–8:00pm weekdays, 10:30–8:30pm weekends
records.official_hours: Mon–Thu 10:30–20:00; Fri–Sun and public holidays 10:30–20:30. Food court and restaurants 11:00–21:30.
records.official_location: 63 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul. Hoehyeon Station (Line 4) Exit 7, about 220 m.
records.notes: Submitted hours match the official hours. The store is at 63 Sogong-ro (Hoehyeon Station), not on the Myeongdong street itself.

records.submitted: Department store hours (Lotte/Shinsegae): 10:30–8:00pm weekdays, 10:30–8:30pm weekends
records.official_hours: Opening hours 10:30–20:00 (standard); extended to 20:30 on some days (Customer Service weekends and holidays 10:30–20:30). Food court 10:30–21:00. The store page also shows 'Closed — Monday, 09 Nov.'
records.official_location: 81 Namdaemun-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul. Euljiro 1-ga Station (Line 2) Exit 7, directly connected.
records.notes: Submitted hours match the standard and extended official hours. Important: the official store page shows the store closed on Monday 9 Nov 2026, which is the Day 9 travel day. Check before any Myeongdong shopping on Nov 9.

records.notes: Food-alley closing at 23:00 matches. 'Stalls open until 2:00 a.m.', the hand-cut noodle claim and the Netflix reference are not confirmed by an official source.

records.item: Gyeongbokgung Palace – plan date Tuesday, Nov 3
records.submitted: Gyeongbokgung Palace (Hours: November–February 9:00–5:00pm, last admission 4:00. Closed: Tuesdays)
records.official_hours: Nov–Dec and Jan–Feb: 09:00–17:00 (final admission 16:00). Closed on Tuesdays.
records.notes: CRITICAL: Nov 3, 2026 is a Tuesday and the palace is closed. The submitted hours match the official hours, but the planned date does not. Move the palace visit to an open day (Mon Nov 2, or Wed Nov 4 or later).

records.submitted: Must-see: Main palace of Joseon Dynasty, changing of the guard ceremony (10:00 AM, 2:00 PM, closed on Tuesdays)
records.official_hours: Changing of the Royal Guard: 10:00 and 14:00 (about 20 min). Gwanghwamun guard duty: 11:00 and 13:00. Training: 09:35 and 13:35.
records.official_detail: The palace is closed on Tuesdays (see D3-01), so the ceremony does not run on Tuesdays.
records.notes: Times match. The ceremony does not run on Tuesdays, so this item cannot take place on Nov 3.

records.submitted: Admission: 3,000 KRW (~$2.30), Free for under 19 and over 65
records.official_fee: Ages 19–64: ₩3,000 (group of 10+: ₩2,400). Ages 7–18: ₩1,500 (group: ₩1,200). Free: ages 6 and under and 65 and over. Hanbok wearers: free (official page does not restate this rule).
records.notes: 'Free under 19' is incorrect. Ages 7–18 pay ₩1,500. The USD conversion is not verified.
